title: OmniReasoning: Pushing the Limits of Audio-Visual Joint Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language. However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited. We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method. First, we introduce OmniReasoningBench, a benchmark where both audio and visual evidence are indispensable. It comprises 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video. Second, we develop a data engine OmniQA. It automatically constructs evidence-grounded QA pairs that explicitly necessitate audio-visual joint reasoning, together with time-stamped clue chains that guide the annotation of thinking process. Besides our benchmark, this engine produces training data OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniR

translated_title: OmniReasoning：突破音视频联合推理的极限
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.39490v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）。最新进展已使统一的全模态模型能够理解音频、视觉和语言。然而，现有的基准测试、训练数据和学习方法大多将各模态独立处理，导致音视频联合推理能力既缺乏充分评估，也未被有效激发。我们通过一个基准测试、一个数据引擎和一种学习方法来填补这一空白。首先，我们提出 OmniReasoningBench，这是一个音频与视觉证据均不可或缺的基准测试，包含 1,150 道多选题和开放式问答题，涵盖两项任务：视频内推理和超越视频的推理。其次，我们开发了数据引擎 OmniQA，它能自动构建明确需要音视频联合推理的、以证据为基础的问答对，并附带带时间戳的线索链，用以引导思维过程的标注。除基准测试外，该引擎还生成了训练数据 OmniReasoning-SFT-112K 和 OmniR……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 OmniReasoningBench 基准、OmniQA 数据引擎及相应学习方法，以系统评估并激发全模态模型中音视频联合推理的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OmniReasoningBench, the OmniQA data engine, and a corresponding learning method to systematically evaluate and elicit audio-visual joint reasoning in omni-modal models.
